all.source_quote: Must be 18 years or above at the time of registration

unmodelled.text: Must be an artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools in a notified trade
unmodelled.source_quote: Applicant must be an artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools in one of the notified traditional trades

unmodelled.text: Must be self-employed in the unorganised sector
unmodelled.source_quote: Should be self-employed in the unorganised sector

unmodelled.text: Must work in one of the 18 family-based trades: carpenter, boat maker, armourer, blacksmith, hammer and toolkit maker, locksmith, sculptor, goldsmith, potter, cobbler, mason, basket/mat/broom/coir maker, doll and toy maker, barber, garland maker, washerman, tailor, fishing net maker
unmodelled.source_quote: Must be actively engaged in one of the 18 specified family-based traditional trades

unmodelled.text: Must be practising the trade when registering
unmodelled.source_quote: Applicant should be practicing the trade at the time of registration

unmodelled.text: No similar government self-employment loan (PMEGP, Mudra, SVANidhi) in the last 5 years
unmodelled.source_quote: Should not have availed similar government self-employment loans (e.g., PMEGP, Mudra, SVANidhi) in the last 5 years
Only one member per family is eligible to avail benefits under the scheme

unmodelled.text: Government employees and their families are not eligible
unmodelled.source_quote: Government employees and their family members are not eligible

unmodelled.text: The 18 trades as listed on the page
unmodelled.source_quote: Carpenter, Boat maker, Armourer, Black smith, Hammer and Toolkit maker, Lock smith, Sculpture, Gold smith, potter, cobbler, Masions, Basket/Mat/Broom maker/Coir waiver, Doll and Toy maker, Barber, Garland maker, Washerman, Toiler, Fishing Net maker

ambiguous: Source is a short summary by the Department of Information & Cultural Affairs on wb.gov.in, not the scheme's own guidelines
Trades are not modelled because the occupation field is free text

en.title: PM Vishwakarma
en.benefit: Certificate and ID card, free training with Rs 500 a day, Rs 15,000 toolkit help, and collateral-free loans up to Rs 3 lakh at about 5%.
en.how_to_apply: Register through the official PM Vishwakarma channel described on the source page.
